name: Inventory Intelligence for WooCommerce
author: dustingunter

sections.description:
Inventory Intelligence for WooCommerce brings tactical-grade inventory analytics to your store.
It analyzes recent sales velocity, predicts stockout dates, and calculates reorder trigger points dynamically based on your chosen time horizon (30, 60, 90, 180, or 365 days).

Key Features:
– Dynamic sales velocity based on real order data (30-365 day selectable windows)
– Frozen capital tracking based on landed cost
– Reorder trigger forecasts based on lead time
– Projected out-of-stock date calculations
– Visual urgency warnings for products needing attention
– Clean CSV export for procurement teams or offline planning
– Lightweight, admin-friendly, no front-end bloat

Take the guesswork out of inventory management and reclaim full tactical control.

Note:
This plugin may contain affiliate links in documentation or support materials. Affiliate links help support future development at no additional cost to you. Thank you for your support!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/inventory-intelligence-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Inventory Intelligence from your WooCommerce dashboard to start optimizing.
sections.faq:
Does this affect front-end customer experience?

No. Inventory Intelligence is purely a back-end tactical tool for store operators.

Is this plugin compatible with variations?

Yes. Variation-level sales and inventory are fully supported.

How often is the data updated?

Data is pulled dynamically when you load the dashboard. No scheduled jobs or cron needed.

Will more features be added?

Yes! Planned features include supplier linking, low stock email alerts, and smart replenishment reports.
